description: This file defines data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for implementing 'git grep' functionality, including pattern matching, color configuration, and source management.

methods.name: grep_config
methods.description: Configures grep options based on variable and value.

methods.name: grep_init
methods.description: Initializes grep options with repository context.

methods.name: append_grep_pat
methods.description: Appends a pattern to grep options.

methods.name: append_grep_pattern
methods.description: Appends a pattern with origin to grep options.

methods.name: append_header_grep_pattern
methods.description: Appends a header pattern to grep options.

methods.name: compile_grep_patterns
methods.description: Compiles all patterns in grep options.

methods.name: free_grep_patterns
methods.description: Frees pattern resources in grep options.

methods.name: grep_next_match
methods.description: Finds next match in buffer with grep options.

methods.name: grep_source_init_oid
methods.description: Initializes grep source from object ID.
